channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Ocient raises $100M Series C to accelerate agentic AI analytics
item.description: Ocient raised $100M in Series C funding to accelerate its agentic AI analytics platform for petabyte-scale data, bringing total funding to $260M.

item.title: Microsoft adds Dynamic Permissions and Execution Containers for agent security
item.description: Microsoft added task-scoped Dynamic Permissions for AI agents, made Execution Containers generally available, and expanded Defender to discover local agents and their MCP setups.

item.title: x402 passes 197 million settled payments
item.description: A live tracker counts over 197 million x402 payments settled and $42.45 million in volume as of November 5, with Base the largest chain.

item.title: Orca extends AI AppGen Security to Base44's Compliance API
item.description: Orca Security extended its AI AppGen Security platform to Base44 on day one of Base44's new Compliance API, checking no-code workspaces against 30+ security rules.

item.title: Sand.ai raises $200M Series A+ for generative video models
item.description: Sand.ai raised $200M in Series A+ funding to build generative video models, bringing its 2026 total to about $300M.

item.title: Cyberhaven launches Agentic Data Security to watch what AI agents do with company data
item.description: Cyberhaven launched Agentic Data Security, which shows what AI agents do with company data and stops sensitive data before it leaves.

item.title: Citrix adds SecurSpaces and SecurAccess for governed agentic work
item.description: Citrix added SecurSpaces and SecurAccess, giving AI agents isolated sandboxes and audited sessions inside enterprise workspaces.

item.title: Fingerprint can now detect hidden Muse, Instinct and Grok bot traffic
item.description: Fingerprint expanded bot detection to identify undeclared traffic from AI agents including Meta's Muse, Instinct and xAI's Grok Bot.

item.title: Base44 and Overwolf's Nitro launch $65K contest for AI-built web games
item.description: Base44 and Overwolf's Nitro launched a $65K contest for web games built with AI, with a $25,000 grand prize.

item.title: OpenAI ships ChatGPT Images 2.6 with animated GIFs and two new API models
item.description: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.6 with animated GIFs and two faster API models, Flare and Sunburst, for quicker image generation and editing.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude Marketplace with 14 new partner agents
item.description: Anthropic added 14 partner agents to Claude Marketplace, including security and productivity tools, now payable from committed Anthropic spend.

item.title: Anthropic adds message threads to Messages API in public beta
item.description: Anthropic added message threads to its Messages API in public beta, caching conversations server-side to cut latency on long Claude Code sessions.

item.title: WhatsApp Business Platform: INR billing migration deadline is Dec 31, 2026
item.description: Indian businesses on WhatsApp must switch messaging accounts to INR billing by December 31, 2026, or messages stop delivering from January 1.

item.description: x402 agent payments passed 196 million settled transactions and $42.4 million in volume, though October cooled sharply after a late-2025 minting frenzy.

item.title: PhoenixAI launches Contextbase, governed context infrastructure for AI agents
item.description: PhoenixAI launched Contextbase, putting agent memory, knowledge, traces and evaluations in one governed store inside its database.

item.description: Snowflake launched Business Ontology and expanded its Cortex AI Gateway to govern AI agents with approved business definitions.

item.title: OpenAI Agent Builder shuts down November 30: 26-day migration playbook
item.description: OpenAI's Agent Builder shuts down November 30, so teams have 26 days to export workflows to the Agents SDK or Workspace Agents.

item.description: A new x402 service lets AI agents pay $0.004 per 10 web searches in stablecoins, with no API key or account needed.

item.description: OpenKruise Agents v0.6.0 manages AI agent sandboxes on Kubernetes at scale, keeping API keys out of the sandbox with credential injection.

item.title: Platformr adds Optics Tag Manager agent and Remote MCP Server for AWS governance
item.description: Platformr added an AI Tag Manager and an MCP server so cloud teams can audit and apply AWS resource tags in plain English.
